notes.title: Patch Note - 250910
notes.content:
🌍 New Stuff
New Color Blind Mode 🎨 — so everyone can see the world in full color (or without).

Updated loading screen with handy tips 🧠⏳.

New skyboxes (outside the demo) 🌌 — the sky, now in deluxe version.

Some mysterious post-its have appeared… or maybe not 👀


🛠️ Fixes & Improvements
Adjusted translations — words that finally make sense!

Updated sound for mechanical doors 🚪🔊 — clank guaranteed.

Medals rebalanced 🏅 — no more rewards that were too easy (or too hard).

World names updated

New invert Y-axis option 🎮 — up is down, down is up, if that’s your thing.

notes.title: Rollbot Demo - Patch Notes – 250830
notes.content:
🌍 New Stuff
Added new languages! 🌐 Rollbot now speaks a total of 24 languages so even more players can join the fun:
Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Dutch, English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Turkish, Russian, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Greek, Indonesian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.
🛠 Fixes & Improvements
Some Chinese characters were playing hide and seek 👀 … we found them and made them visible again!

Ghosts were a bit shy when changing levels 👻 — now they’ll load properly and haunt your tracks as intended.

notes.title: Demo - PatchNote - 250829
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve just released a small update for the demo version of the game. This patch focuses on fixing some reported issues and polishing a few details:

🌍 Added more translations

👻 Fixed an issue where the player ghost was not appearing in the demo version

📘 Improved tutorial maps and interfaces for better clarity

⬇️ Fixed a bug that prevented downloading multiple ghosts at the same time

Thank you all for playing the demo and sharing your feedback — it helps us a lot in improving the game before release! 🙏

If you encounter any other issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to let us know on the Steam forums or our Discord Server.
